question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
-- Verify the averages
WITH region_weekly AS (
  SELECT region, week_date, SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY region, week_date
),
platform_weekly AS (
  SELECT platform, week_date, SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY platform, week_date
),
age_band_weekly AS (
  SELECT age_band, week_date, SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY age_band, week_date
),
demographic_weekly AS (
  SELECT demographic, week_date, SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY demographic, week_date
),
customer_type_weekly AS (
  SELECT customer_type, week_date, SUM(sales) as total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY customer_type, week_date
),
region_avgs AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr_type, region as attr_value,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) < DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_before,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) > DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_after
  FROM region_weekly GROUP BY region
),
platform_avgs AS (
  SELECT 'platform' as attr_type, platform as attr_value,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) < DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_before,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) > DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_after
  FROM platform_weekly GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_avgs AS (
  SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type, age_band as attr_value,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) < DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_before,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) > DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_after
  FROM age_band_weekly GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_avgs AS (
  SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type, demographic as attr_value,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) < DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_before,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) > DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_after
  FROM demographic_weekly GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_avgs AS (
  SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type, customer_type as attr_value,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) < DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_before,
    AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(week_date AS DATE) > DATE '2020-06-15' THEN total_sales END) as avg_after
  FROM customer_type_weekly GROUP BY customer_type
),
all_avgs AS (
  SELECT * FROM region_avgs
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM platform_avgs
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM age_band_avgs
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM demographic_avgs
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM customer_type_avgs
),
pct_changes AS (
  SELECT attr_type, attr_value,
    CASE WHEN avg_before IS NOT NULL AND avg_before != 0 
      THEN 1.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / avg_before * 100 
      ELSE NULL END as pct_change
  FROM all_avgs
)
SELECT attr_type, COUNT(*) as num_values, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change, MIN(pct_change) as min_pct, MAX(pct_change) as max_pct
FROM pct_changes
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change
